name: 42885-decode1k-16b-1gpu
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), SM90.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP off. One vLLM engine in one process, no NCCL.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams 16 then 4 then 1 — three benchmarks in one guidellm run, each with its own bound. Warmup the first 25% by completion, bounded at 128 requests with an 1800 s safety cap per point; about 96 requests are scored at each.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets: prompt EXACTLY 1024 tokens and output EXACTLY 1024 (min = max = 1024), greedy (temperature 0.0), and ignore_eos is forced whenever max_tokens is set, so all 1024 tokens are always generated.
purpose: A long-form writing assistant generating 1024-token replies from 1024-token prompts for up to 16 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# ENGINE: commit cd49a05d5aa3cc296912297b3c2b577efe4183c8 (`v0.21.1rc0-82-gcd49a05d5aa3`). The
# interpreter and the hardware seal live in configs/env.yaml.
#
# FORMAT HAZARD: the flat reader skips any line that starts with a space, so every key must be
# top-level and every value must fit on ONE line.

model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat
attention-backend: TRITON_MLA
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
# 4096, not 16384. The workload is EXACTLY 1024 in + 1024 out, so 4096 is the nearest power of two
# with headroom.
max-model-len: 4096
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
